The '''Pius Dea's Supreme Temple''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was the sect's largest temple. It was built sometime during the [[Pius Dea Crusades]] when the sect ruled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a theocracy. Following the collapse of [[Pius Dea]] rule during the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict]] and the capture of the last Pius Dea [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Contispex XIX]], the Supreme Temple was destroyed after an anti-Pius Dea coalition led by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] took over the Republic and its institutions.
